statusMeaning.pending: The criterion has an explicit route/evidence contract but the current local slice does not claim support.
statusMeaning.smoke: A staged browser smoke proves the local route and evidence checkpoint without claiming the full criterion.

criteria.summary: Custom form types, required flags, public rendering, and validation.
criteria.routeContract: Start at /; use visible organizer CFP/form-builder controls, then the logged-out public form.
criteria.checkpoint: Builder shows field types and required state; public form shows options; empty required submission shows an error.

criteria.summary: Conditional form field toggles from a visible answer.
criteria.routeContract: Start at /; follow visible form-builder and public-form controls; do not call form internals.
criteria.checkpoint: Dependent field is visible for the controlling value and hidden for the alternate value.

criteria.summary: Anonymous branded CFP portal with deadline and selectable options.
criteria.routeContract: Start at /; obtain the public URL through visible UI; open it in a fresh logged-out context.
criteria.checkpoint: Event name, deadline, tracks, and formats are rendered without organizer access.

criteria.summary: Closed submission window blocks new public submissions.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer settings to close the call, then reopen its public URL logged out.
criteria.checkpoint: Closed state is visible and no new-submission action remains.

criteria.summary: Speaker signup, proposal submission, confirmation, and own dashboard status.
criteria.routeContract: Start at the public URL from visible UI; use the speaker-facing signup and submission controls.
criteria.checkpoint: A proposal is submitted, confirmation is rendered, and the speaker dashboard lists its status.

criteria.summary: Submitted fields round-trip to organizer views.
criteria.routeContract: Use the visible speaker submission flow, then switch identities through the visible sign-out/login UI.
criteria.checkpoint: Organizer list/detail preserves title, abstract, options, and custom values.

criteria.summary: In-progress proposal can be saved and resumed.
criteria.routeContract: Use only the visible draft/save controls in the public or speaker form.
criteria.checkpoint: A title-only draft has a visible draft state and resumes with saved content.

criteria.summary: Submission creates confirmation email or visible local outbox evidence.
criteria.routeContract: Submit through the visible public form; inspect only an in-app outbox if the UI exposes one.
criteria.checkpoint: Recipient and submitted title appear in a rendered confirmation/outbox record.

criteria.summary: Open CFP edits persist and reach organizer view.
criteria.routeContract: Use speaker dashboard/edit controls, reload, then use visible organizer detail controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Edited abstract survives reload and matches organizer-side content.

criteria.summary: Reviewer provisioning separates reviewer surface from organizer capabilities.
criteria.routeContract: Provision through visible organizer controls and sign in through the public root; no token guessing.
criteria.checkpoint: Reviewer lands on a reviewer surface with no organizer navigation.

criteria.summary: Reviewer rating/comment persists and completion updates.
criteria.routeContract: Use the visible assigned-review route in a reviewer browser context, then inspect organizer view.
criteria.checkpoint: Rating and comment are stored; reviewer completion and organizer visibility agree.

criteria.summary: Organizer records distinct accept/reject decisions.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer submission-list/detail decision controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Accepted and rejected rows remain distinct after reload.

criteria.summary: Decision statuses propagate to the speaker dashboard.
criteria.routeContract: Record decisions visibly, sign out, and use the speaker-facing dashboard.
criteria.checkpoint: The speaker sees the corresponding accepted/rejected states.

criteria.summary: Decision notifications can be sent or queued with confirmation.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer notification controls for decided submissions only.
criteria.checkpoint: UI confirms recipient set and sent/queued result.

criteria.summary: Accepted proposal becomes a session without re-entry.
criteria.routeContract: Accept through visible organizer controls, then follow visible agenda/program navigation.
criteria.checkpoint: Session retains accepted title, speaker, and track.

criteria.summary: Closed CFP makes speaker submissions read-only.
criteria.routeContract: Close through visible organizer settings, then open the speaker submission through its dashboard.
criteria.checkpoint: Edit is absent/blocked and a save cannot change content.

criteria.summary: Organizer can create and switch between multiple events.
criteria.routeContract: Search only visible organizer navigation for event list/switcher/create controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Two event records coexist and each has a reachable event surface.

criteria.summary: Event-scoped records do not leak between events.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible event navigation to compare the first and second event surfaces.
criteria.checkpoint: Second event shows only its own submissions/sessions/speakers.

criteria.summary: Independent review rounds with distinct dates and scorecards persist.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer review-plan controls under the event review surface.
criteria.checkpoint: Reloaded plan shows two named rounds, dates, and different scorecards.

criteria.summary: Reviewer pools are scoped per round.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible round-specific reviewer-pool controls; do not infer scope from URLs.
criteria.checkpoint: Reviewer in round one is not implicitly in round two.

criteria.summary: Scorecard supports numeric, dropdown, and free-text fields.
criteria.routeContract: Configure visibly, then review the same scorecard in a separate reviewer browser context.
criteria.checkpoint: All field types render and submitted values reload.

criteria.summary: Weighted criteria persist and affect labeled aggregates.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible scorecard weight controls and visible results/aggregate views.
criteria.checkpoint: Weight configuration and weighted/unweighted method are explicit after reload.

criteria.summary: Reviewer queue contains exactly assigned submissions.
criteria.routeContract: Assign visibly, then inspect the reviewer queue in an isolated browser context.
criteria.checkpoint: Assigned titles appear; unassigned title is absent or denied.
evidence: reviewer queue and denied unassigned access

criteria.summary: Assignment has a cap, filter, or automatic distribution control.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible assignment tooling and record the exercised operation.
criteria.checkpoint: At-scale control is visible and changes assignment state without error.

criteria.summary: Blind reviewer view hides authors while organizer view shows them.
criteria.routeContract: Enable visible round anonymization; compare reviewer and organizer browser contexts.
criteria.checkpoint: Author strings are absent from reviewer view and present for organizer.

criteria.summary: Reviewer progress counts track assigned and completed work.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible progress view before and after reviewer submissions.
criteria.checkpoint: Counts/percentages change to match the recorded review state.

criteria.summary: Organizer can remind reviewers with outstanding work.
criteria.routeContract: Select a lagging reviewer through visible progress/reviewer controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Reminder action reports a sent/queued result.

criteria.summary: Results show aggregates and sort by score in both directions.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer results table and score sort control.
criteria.checkpoint: Aggregate values render and row order changes descending/ascending.

criteria.summary: Co-authors persist with role labels.
criteria.routeContract: Add co-author through visible submission controls; inspect speaker and organizer views.
criteria.checkpoint: Co-author name and role survive reload in organizer review/results.

criteria.summary: Reviewer can declare conflict or recuse.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible conflict/recusal control on an assigned review page.
criteria.checkpoint: Wording and resulting flagged/removed state are rendered.

criteria.summary: Review results can be exported to a downloadable file.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer results/reports export controls; do not inspect hidden filesystem paths.
criteria.checkpoint: Download starts or UI confirms a generated file and filename.

criteria.summary: If AI review is claimed, score/rationale and human override are distinguishable.
criteria.routeContract: Inspect only visible product claims and AI controls; if none exist, record an honest no-AI observation.
criteria.checkpoint: Claimed AI score/rationale and persisted override are visible, or the no-AI path is explicit.
evidence: visible AI claim/control or no-AI observation

criteria.summary: Speaker roster lists identity fields and supports search/filter.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer event-speakers route and roster controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Roster renders identities; search/filter narrows and clears.

criteria.summary: Organizer can add and edit speaker profile fields.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer add/edit speaker controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Name, email, bio, title/company, and organizer edit persist after reload.

criteria.summary: Speaker CSV import creates or merges roster records.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer import control and the repository-owned synthetic CSV fixture.
criteria.checkpoint: Import completes and the new fixture speaker is visible in the roster.

criteria.summary: Speaker workflow status changes, persists, and filters.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible roster status control and status filter.
criteria.checkpoint: Changed status survives reload and filter membership agrees.

criteria.summary: General tasks have due dates and multiple speaker assignees.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer task controls linked to canonical speaker records.
criteria.checkpoint: Three fixture tasks render with due dates and intended assignees.

criteria.summary: Organizer can invite/onboard a speaker.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible per-speaker or bulk invitation controls.
criteria.checkpoint: UI confirms an invitation or onboarding message was sent/queued.

criteria.summary: Speaker portal is personalized and own-content scoped.
criteria.routeContract: Enter through visible speaker login/invite flow and inspect the portal as that speaker.
criteria.checkpoint: Own identity/content is present; another speaker's records and admin navigation are absent.

criteria.summary: Speaker portal profile edits round-trip bio, socials, and headshot.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible speaker profile edit/upload controls, then visible organizer profile view.
criteria.checkpoint: Sentinel bio/social/headshot persist and appear to organizer.

criteria.summary: Speaker task list shows deadlines and persistent completion.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible speaker tasks portal controls and reload after completion.
criteria.checkpoint: Completed tasks remain complete while untouched task remains incomplete.

criteria.summary: Organizer can view/download speaker-uploaded file metadata.
criteria.routeContract: Upload through visible speaker portal, then use visible organizer file/profile controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Filename and uploader/time metadata render; view/download responds.

criteria.summary: Session assignment appears for organizer and speaker.
criteria.routeContract: Link visibly, then inspect both organizer record and speaker portal.
criteria.checkpoint: Same session title appears in both surfaces.

criteria.summary: Organizer progress view reflects per-speaker task completion.
criteria.routeContract: Complete tasks visibly as speaker, then return to organizer progress view.
criteria.checkpoint: Per-speaker completion state changes and optional filter narrows correctly.

criteria.summary: Organizer can send a logged bulk email to selected speakers.
criteria.routeContract: Select visible speaker rows and use visible communication controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Composer/send result identifies selected recipients and logs the send.

criteria.summary: Email templates resolve merge fields per recipient.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible template/composer preview controls; do not inspect provider traffic.
criteria.checkpoint: Preview or rendered log shows recipient-specific merge values.

criteria.summary: Travel/logistics custom fields persist on a speaker.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer or speaker profile field controls.
criteria.checkpoint: A logistics value survives save and reload.

criteria.summary: Incomplete-task reminders are visible and triggerable.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer task/reminder controls against speakers with incomplete work.
criteria.checkpoint: Reminder recipient and sent/queued result are rendered.

criteria.summary: Organizer creates a file-request task with instructions and due date.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer content/task controls linked to speakers.
criteria.checkpoint: File-request task renders with instruction, due date, and assignees.

criteria.summary: Speaker uploads a file against an assigned task/session.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible speaker task portal upload control.
criteria.checkpoint: Upload completes and is attached to the task/session.

criteria.summary: Speaker content scope excludes organizer/admin views.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible speaker portal entry and navigation only; verify organizer route is unavailable.
criteria.checkpoint: Speaker sees own tasks/sessions and no admin capabilities.

criteria.summary: Re-upload creates a visible new file version.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible task upload twice with repository-owned synthetic files.
criteria.checkpoint: Latest version is marked while previous version remains accessible.

criteria.summary: File comments persist with author and timestamp across roles.
criteria.routeContract: Add comments through visible file controls, then inspect from other authorized role.
criteria.checkpoint: Comment author/time and text render after reload.

criteria.summary: Upload UI communicates accepted types or size limits.
criteria.routeContract: Open the visible speaker upload control.
criteria.checkpoint: File constraints are rendered at the point of upload.

criteria.summary: Deliverables dashboard tracks per-speaker/task state with filters.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer deliverables dashboard and filter controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Upload changes matching speaker/task status and filtered results.

criteria.summary: Organizer sends bulk reminders for outstanding deliverables.
criteria.routeContract: Select visible outstanding tasks/speakers and use reminder action.
criteria.checkpoint: Send result reports affected recipients.

criteria.summary: Central admin edits session title and abstract.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer session/content editor.
criteria.checkpoint: Title and abstract persist after reload.

criteria.summary: Admin edits speaker bio and headshot.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer speaker profile editor and upload control.
criteria.checkpoint: Bio/headshot survive reload.

criteria.summary: Content edits have attributable history and restore.
criteria.routeContract: Edit visibly, open visible history, and use visible restore control if available.
criteria.checkpoint: Prior version, editor/time, and restored value are rendered.

criteria.summary: Approval status gates public agenda visibility.
criteria.routeContract: Set visible session approval state, then inspect visible public agenda surface.
criteria.checkpoint: Approved session is shown; unapproved session is excluded.

criteria.summary: Central files library shows session/speaker metadata and versions.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer files library and optional session file tab.
criteria.checkpoint: Uploaded file metadata and version count agree across surfaces.

criteria.summary: Multi-select export creates a latest-version bulk download.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer file/session selection and export controls.
criteria.checkpoint: ZIP/export generation or download is confirmed.

criteria.summary: Multi-day schedule builder has time, room/track, and day navigation.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer event program/schedule route and day controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Time dimension and location/track structure render for multiple days.

criteria.summary: Organizer-created rooms and tracks are usable in the builder.
criteria.routeContract: Create through visible organizer room/track controls, then return to schedule.
criteria.checkpoint: New room/track appears as an assignable/displayed option.

criteria.summary: Session placement into day/time/room persists.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible schedule placement controls or drag alternative; reload the same route.
criteria.checkpoint: Placed session remains in the selected slot after reload.

criteria.summary: Overlapping sessions for one speaker visibly warn.
criteria.routeContract: Schedule two sessions visibly with the same speaker at an overlapping time.
criteria.checkpoint: Warning identifies speaker or conflicting sessions.

criteria.summary: Overlapping sessions in one room block or warn.
criteria.routeContract: Attempt the overlap through visible room/slot controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Placement is rejected or room conflict is clearly rendered.

criteria.summary: Moving a session clears resolved speaker/room conflicts.
criteria.routeContract: Move visibly to a non-conflicting slot/room and reload.
criteria.checkpoint: New placement persists and prior warnings clear.

criteria.summary: Publish action hands scheduled data to an attendee-facing surface.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer publish/go-live control, then follow visible public/attendee link.
criteria.checkpoint: Publish result and scheduled session are both rendered.

criteria.summary: One-action assisted placement puts an unscheduled session into a slot.
criteria.routeContract: Use only a visible auto-schedule/assist control in the builder.
criteria.checkpoint: Previously unscheduled session gains a visible slot.

criteria.summary: Sessions list cards show core session metadata and expandable description.
criteria.routeContract: Open a non-admin public/attendee widget surface reached through visible UI.
criteria.checkpoint: At least three cards render title, description, time, room, speaker, format, and track.

criteria.summary: Sessions list searches by title and speaker.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible widget search input on the attendee-facing surface.
criteria.checkpoint: Title and surname searches narrow visible cards and result count.

criteria.summary: Sessions list has a track filter and narrowing behavior.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible widget filter controls; do not query widget internals.
criteria.checkpoint: Selected facet leaves only matching cards and can clear.

criteria.summary: Speaker list directory renders photo, identity, title, and company.
criteria.routeContract: Open visible non-admin speaker-list widget route.
criteria.checkpoint: Directory entries render metadata and surname ordering is observable.

criteria.summary: Speaker directory search and detail show bio and sessions.
criteria.routeContract: Search visibly, open a speaker entry, and use visible back/close control.
criteria.checkpoint: Detail includes bio and session metadata; search narrows directory.

criteria.summary: Agenda widget is structured by day/time/location.
criteria.routeContract: Open visible attendee-facing agenda surface after publish if required.
criteria.checkpoint: Time/room structure and session block metadata render.

criteria.summary: Agenda day navigation changes label and sessions.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible day tabs/chevrons/date control on the agenda.
criteria.checkpoint: Second day visibly differs in label and rendered content.

criteria.summary: Agenda block detail shows full session fields and returns.
criteria.routeContract: Open a visible agenda block and use visible back/close control.
criteria.checkpoint: Detail shows time range, room, description, format, and track.

criteria.summary: Schedule itinerary lists complete chronological session cards.
criteria.routeContract: Open visible attendee itinerary and day sections/tabs.
criteria.checkpoint: Cards show track, title, description, time, room, and all speakers in order.

criteria.summary: Attendee can build a personal schedule and remove one item.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible star/add controls and personal-schedule view.
criteria.checkpoint: Exactly chosen sessions appear; removing one updates the list.

criteria.summary: Personal schedule survives reload and offers export/calendar.
criteria.routeContract: Reload the attendee-facing itinerary/personal view and use visible export/calendar control.
criteria.checkpoint: Selection persists and export action confirms.

criteria.summary: Speaker gallery has photo cards, search, ordering, and fallbacks.
criteria.routeContract: Open visible non-admin gallery surface and use its search input.
criteria.checkpoint: Photo grid renders metadata and handles missing photo/title without breaking.

criteria.summary: Gallery detail shows speaker profile and sessions, then restores grid.
criteria.routeContract: Open a visible gallery card and close/back through rendered controls.
criteria.checkpoint: Detail includes photo, identity, bio, company, and session list.

criteria.summary: All implemented widget surfaces are available to non-admin viewers.
criteria.routeContract: Open each visible public/attendee/embed surface in a non-admin browser context.
criteria.checkpoint: Five surfaces render populated content without organizer rights.

criteria.summary: Organizer can configure and retrieve saved widget embed code/feed.
criteria.routeContract: Use visible organizer embed/widget controls and saved-embed list.
criteria.checkpoint: Widget configuration and retrievable snippet/feed URL are rendered.

criteria.summary: Widget data stays consistent with organizer source across surfaces.
criteria.routeContract: Compare visible organizer record with at least two attendee-facing widget surfaces.
criteria.checkpoint: Sample title, time, room, track, and speaker fields match.
